SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS candidate_count,
    SUM(funded_amnt) AS total_funded_amnt,
    AVG(funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt,
    AVG(int_rate) AS avg_int_rate
FROM loans_fact
WHERE application_type = 'Individual'
  AND annual_inc >= 70000
  AND dti IS NOT NULL
  AND dti <= 36

WITH filtered_candidates AS (
    SELECT 
        funded_amnt,
        int_rate
    FROM loans_fact
    WHERE application_type = 'Individual'
      AND annual_inc >= 70000
      AND dti IS NOT NULL
      AND dti <= 36
)
SELECT 
    COUNT(*) AS candidate_count,
    SUM(funded_amnt) AS total_funded_amnt,
    AVG(funded_amnt) AS avg_funded_amnt,
    AVG(int_rate) AS avg_int_rate
FROM filtered_candidates

SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN application_type != 'Individual' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_app_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN application_type = 'Individual' AND annual_inc < 70000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_annual_inc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN application_type = 'Individual' AND annual_inc >= 70000 AND (dti IS NULL OR dti > 36) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_dti,
    SUM(CASE WHEN application_type = 'Individual' AND annual_inc >= 70000 AND dti IS NOT NULL AND dti <= 36 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS passed_all_criteria,
    COUNT(*) AS total_candidates
FROM loans_fact

WITH candidate_breakdown AS (
    SELECT 
        CASE 
            WHEN application_type != 'Individual' THEN 'rejected_app_type'
            WHEN annual_inc < 70000 THEN 'rejected_annual_inc'
            WHEN dti IS NULL OR dti > 36 THEN 'rejected_dti'
            ELSE 'passed_all_criteria'
        END AS rejection_category,
        COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM loans_fact
    GROUP BY 
        CASE 
            WHEN application_type != 'Individual' THEN 'rejected_app_type'
            WHEN annual_inc < 70000 THEN 'rejected_annual_inc'
            WHEN dti IS NULL OR dti > 36 THEN 'rejected_dti'
            ELSE 'passed_all_criteria'
        END
)
SELECT 
    SUM(CASE WHEN rejection_category = 'rejected_app_type' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_app_type,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rejection_category = 'rejected_annual_inc' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_annual_inc,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rejection_category = 'rejected_dti' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS rejected_dti,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rejection_category = 'passed_all_criteria' THEN cnt ELSE 0 END) AS passed_all_criteria,
    SUM(cnt) AS total_candidates
FROM candidate_breakdown
